verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at amplitude.com/llms.txt that routes agents to an executable install.md entry point. They also confirm a markdown rendering of the Feature Experiment docs page (feature-experiment.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs for this product. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown-docs offering, confirmation that llms.txt specifically indexes Experiment content (it is site-wide Amplitude), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://amplitude.com/llms.txt # Amplitude
For an executable setup entry point, fetch [install.md](https://amplitude.com/install.md).
